title: Cluster 03 Drill — Gene and Chromosomal Mutations, Molecular Techniques and Bioethics
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 2 · 9 questions · 148 marks · cumulative over Cluster 1 + Cluster 2 + Cluster 3 + Book 1
los_html:

Three traps here carry measured failure rates from real examiner reports: the meiosis I against meiosis II deduction in Q7(a), where the nearest published equivalent was answered correctly by only 45.66% of the cohort; the DNA-against-RNA primer point inside Q3(a), at 54.60%; and the expression-profile reading in Q9(a), which the examiner recorded as poorly done because candidates read the bands and then stopped without naming a regulatory cause.

A third of the raw question bank for this cluster is cut content, and none of it appears here. Restriction enzyme recognition sequences, sticky against blunt ends, restriction mapping and RFLP, cloning vectors and plasmids, ligation, insertional inactivation, transformation, gene therapy, DNA sequencing and profiling, Northern blotting and FISH mechanism are all absent from the 9477 syllabus. The one thing that survives is restriction digestion as step one of a Southern blot, because LO 2(j)(iii) asks for the procedure - so Q5(a) names the step and tests nothing about the enzyme.

One warning about Q8. Fifteen years of prelims contain nothing on maternal screening for trisomy 21, and all four 9477 specimen papers contain zero bioethics questions, so Q8 has no past paper behind it and is built from the school's own chapters 2.5 and 2.7. LO 2(m) says discuss and is worth several marks, so build the answer anyway - it is the only question here you cannot check against a real examiner.
